LESSON: ARABIC ALPHABET 1.0 QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you pronounce?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. pronounce the Arabic (10 lessons) َ proper recitation of the Qur’an َ ، ‫ب‬
2. identify alphabet for reading readiness
3. read simple Arabic words for readiness in reciting the Qur’an
4. write Arabic letters for writing readiness from right to left e) appreciate proper articulation of Qur’an alphabet. recitation.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. pronounce the Arabic (10 lessons) َ proper recitation of the Qur’an َ ، ‫ب‬
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to pronounce the Arabic (10 lessons) َ proper recitation of the Qur’an َ ، ‫ب‬. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. identify alphabet for reading readiness
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify alphabet for reading readiness. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. read simple Arabic words for readiness in reciting the Qur’an
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to read simple Arabic words for readiness in reciting the Qur’an. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. write Arabic letters for writing readiness from right to left e) appreciate proper articulation of Qur’an alphabet. recitation.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to write Arabic letters for writing readiness from right to left e) appreciate proper articulation of Qur’an alphabet. recitation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN.
2. Explain Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN.
4. Show that you can: pronounce the Arabic (10 lessons) َ proper recitation of the Qur’an َ ، ‫ب‬
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How do you pronounce?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. pronounce the Arabic (10 lessons) َ proper recitation of the Qur’an َ ، ‫ب‬
2. identify alphabet for reading readiness
3. read simple Arabic words for readiness in reciting the Qur’an
4. write Arabic letters for writing readiness from right to left e) appreciate proper articulation of Qur’an alphabet. recitation.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
